name: mozcode
description: Local symbol-level code intelligence that gives OpenAI models precise AST context instead of whole files.

interface.shortDescription: Precise code context with fewer tokens.
interface.longDescription: MOZCODE gives OpenAI models symbol-level reads, structural search, AST-anchored edits, database schema discovery, and a private local savings dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Map this codebase with MOZCODE before editing.
Find and read the symbol that implements this behavior.
